name: Fejk Novella: Adskaja Obschaga
source:
A young (but in age of consent!) girl found herself in the infernal dormitory amongst the monster guys. A dating simulator came true for her? Will she tame a werewolf, seduce a demon or will she be bitten by a vampire? Or else instead of datings, there’s a fate of steak waiting for her? Oh, just wanderings: most likely, she’ll get the real power and become a new commandant!
Whatever it will be, you get a chance to meet our point of view about the monstrous romance in this anime novel completely in English. Kawaii dialogues, achievements, special secret endings and even a clicker fighting inside!
translation:
一个年轻的（但已达到同意年龄！）女孩发现自己在地狱般的宿舍里，周围都是怪物。约会模拟器对她来说成真了吗？她会驯服狼人、引诱恶魔还是会被吸血鬼咬伤？不然等待她的不是约会，而是牛排的命运？哦，只是闲逛而已：很有可能，她会得到真正的权力，成为新的司令！
无论是什么，你都有机会以完全英文的方式了解我们对这部动漫小说中可怕浪漫的看法。卡哇伊对话、成就、特殊秘密结局，甚至还有点击游戏！
